tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search in-stock products JENNi can deliver to a 5-digit US ZIP: local delivery. Every product returned can be ordered; price is per unit, before the delivery fee. A product with variants and no price is a size or colour family: buy one of its variants. Sized goods are often listed one size per produ

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one product_id: description, images, sizes and colours, and its price and delivery at the ZIP.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Returns a hosted checkout_url for an exact product and selected fulfillment mode using the delivery ZIP or address. For several products, pass items instead of product_id: one checkout_url puts them all in one basket. JENNi selects the source internally. The buyer reviews delivery, tax and the total

tools.name: get_buying_options
tools.description: Price, delivery promise and total before tax for one product_id, ZIP, quantity and mode (local_delivery). Call it when the shopper picks a product, before quoting a total.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read where a JENNi order stands: status, delivery ETA when known, courier tracking and whether the card was charged. Requires the private order_token from the shopper’s JENNi order page (starts jos1_). Read-only; it shows no personal details.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start an order JENNi will deliver, without leaving the chat. Give the exact product_id, the delivery address and the shopper's contact details. Returns the delivery options and the order total. Nothing is charged until complete_checkout. Delivered by JENNi.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Choose local_delivery, or change the quantity, address or contact details of an order started with create_checkout. Call with only checkout_id to re-read it. Returns the order total once a delivery option is chosen.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Place the order. Only after the shopper has approved the total from update_checkout. With the shopper's Stripe shared payment token (spt_...), issued for at least the order total, JENNi charges it and places the order now. Never send card numbers. Delivered by JENNi. payment_token is optional. Witho

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_checkout · Private data: get_order_status, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: complete_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_checkout · Private data: get_order_status, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: complete_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Sized good" → after: "Search in-stock products JENNi can deliver to a 5-digit US ZIP: local delivery. Every product returned can be ordered; price is per unit, before the delivery fee. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
